reponse: The root cause was the Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2 running out of disk after infra PR #221 removed size-based retention, leaving only 7-day time-based retention; the broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC and the consumers stalled [2]. The initial suspicion that PR #388's batch size increase caused the lag was wrong: reverting it changed nothing [3][5], and the change was re-applied later [5]. The outage lasted 2h47m (09:38–12:25 UTC), with events delayed but none lost [2], matching the Sentry consumer timeout window [4].
